name: Ignacio Diago Valeta
tagline: LLM systems in production, and on your own hardware.

headlines.label: In MonkeyGrab, my final degree project at UPV: multimodal RAG on local hardware
Served by GPT-CEU, the web and WhatsApp assistant I built at Grupo CEU
In the team I led as Technical Lead at Auro AI

experience.note: Joined the Inditex technology graduate program.

Led the technical development of a WhatsApp assistant that reads energy and telecom bills and switches users to the best tariff. Owned the back end and set the engineering standard for a team of four.

Built and deployed GPT-CEU, a generative assistant for the group's three universities over web and WhatsApp, wired to institutional data through Azure Functions and RAG. Also built the OCR to CRM pipeline that replaced manual digitization of enrollment forms, in production.
Workshops on robotics, cryptography and programming; guided visits on the history of computing.

education.title: Computer Engineering, Computing specialization
education.note: Final degree project: MonkeyGrab, a multimodal RAG over PDFs that runs entirely on local hardware, with no external APIs.
